release_notes:
- App window now expands correctly when resized — content was previously capped at a fixed width
- Panic Mode (Off/Hold) is now restored automatically when using Read → Burn → Write combo
- Panic Mode combo now updates to reflect the device's actual setting after reading device info
- Added "Enter Raw Table" button in the Bluetooth tab — paste raw config to populate the TX Power Table without connecting to a device
- Fixed layout expanding outside the window when a long firmware file path was loaded in the Burn section
